name: ScriptSentry
tagline: Watch every line. Detect every risk.
notice: Under active development — not a published/stable release. Expect breaking changes; do not treat findings or scores as production-grade yet.
summary: Accuracy and triage overhaul: independent severity/confidence/status, a stricter Confirmed bar, an explainable 0-100 risk score, layered AST/bundler script discovery, and a clear split between actionable findings and security observations. An end-to-end review pass then aligned per-file risk chips with the overall score, cut by-name taint false positives, closed the DNS-rebinding window with one-shot validate-and-pin, and added a privacy-first local-AI summary (Ollama only, deterministic fallback).
highlights: Per-file risk chips use the same evidence-weighted 0-100 model as the overall score (worst-file score), so a file can no longer read CRITICAL next to an overall LOW/MEDIUM.
Taint precision: statically-known values no longer taint by name, and reassignment to a static value clears prior taint in both AST and regex paths.

DNS-rebinding hardening: each target is validated and resolved once, then every connection is pinned to the validated public IP literals (all address families), re-checked per redirect hop; SCRIPTSENTRY_ALLOW_PRIVATE_TARGETS=1 opts out for authorized local/private targets.

Local-first AI summary: --ai ollama sends structured findings (never raw source) to a local Ollama server with automatic fallback to the built-in deterministic summary; cloud LLM providers removed for privacy.
Severity, confidence, triage status and analysis quality are now independent axes; confidence is derived from evidence, never from severity.
Confirmed is reserved for deterministic proof or a demonstrated runtime effect; static source-to-sink flows stay Open for triage.
Every flow reports an analysis quality (high/medium/heuristic) plus explicit limitations instead of overclaiming.
Explainable 0-100 risk score with per-contributor breakdown and an investigate-first priority list on the Overview.
Findings view separates Actionable Findings from Security Observations.
Layered script discovery: AST import/require/import() first, bundler adapters (Webpack/Vite/Next/Parcel) second, regex fallback third.
Dashboard navigation reduced from nine views to five (Overview, Findings, Scripts, Intelligence, Runtime).
Formal accuracy regression suite covering true positives, true negatives, known false positives, edge, minified and obfuscated variants.
One-file launcher (scriptsentry.py): download a single file and run it; on first run it bootstraps the engine from GitHub, installs dependencies and starts the server.
Dashboard setup modal offers a download button for the launcher vs. git clone, plus inline input validation (no more browser alert popups) and an authorized-testing notice.

Local file upload: drag & drop or browse one or more .js/.mjs/.ts files to analyze together with per-file attribution (read in the browser, analyzed only by the local engine); extension and size limits enforced.
Scan options (profile, depth, file cap, workers) now have inline ? tooltips explaining each control.
Real brand identity: inline SVG logo, SVG/PNG favicons, app icons, web manifest, and a 1200x630 Open Graph card.
Split into two pages: index.html (overview / landing) and tool.html (analysis console), sharing one stylesheet and script, with server.py serving the console at / locally.
Scroll experience: staggered reveal-on-scroll for sections and cards, a scroll-progress bar under the sticky header, and active-section nav highlighting (all disabled under prefers-reduced-motion).
Proper heading hierarchy (one h1 per page, h2 sections, h3 cards), skip-to-content link and aria-current navigation.
Landing page: sticky header with a 'Go to tool' button, hero CTAs, What it finds / How it works / Trust / Setup sections, a ScriptSentry-specific 'Connect with me' section and a multi-column footer.
Fixed the launcher download button: cross-origin `download` was ignored by browsers, so the file opened instead of downloading; it now saves via a same-origin blob URL (with a new-tab fallback).
Engine status is an animated pulsing indicator (green/amber/red) instead of a static emoji, and clicking it opens the setup guide.
Setup dialog is wider on large screens (two-column, 900px) and has an X close button, backdrop/Escape dismissal, scroll lock and focus handling.
Target URL and pairing-token inputs are now properly styled (they previously fell through the CSS and rendered unstyled).
Changelog is now a real hosted page (webui/changelog.html) generated from CHANGELOG.md, so the site can never drift from the file that gets edited.
Two guards keep the generated page honest: a test fails when the committed page is stale, and the Pages workflow regenerates it on every deploy.
The changelog page is styled as a document -- one 72ch reading column, a rule between releases, no new colours or type sizes, responsive from the measure itself.
README.md is visitor-facing: it leads with what ScriptSentry is and how to use it, rather than reading as developer notes.
Footer trimmed from nine links to six; the Product column no longer repeats sections the header nav already reaches.
